text:
marta: Noting a livelock during this morning's tenant surge (09:12 UTC). Posting quick hypothesis + action items.

liam: saw the alert. paste the most relevant logs?

marta: logs: prefetch -> demote -> handoff DENIED -> immediate retry -> repeat until credits exhausted.

marta: ```
09:11:57 prefetch tenant=acme id=42 attempt=1 prefetched=0
09:11:57 handoff lease=lx1 result=DENIED demote_count=1
09:11:58 prefetch attempt=2 prefetched=0 demote_reason=tombstone
09:11:58 handoff lease=lx2 result=DENIED demote_count=2
09:11:59 prefetch attempt=3 backoff=0s
```

ana: why zero backoff? didn't we add exp backoff?

marta: admission path bypasses backoff for tombstone/evict_hint to favor cold reads; we missed multi-tenant surge case.

tessa: DENIED maps to immediate retry, so no cooldown.

liam: root cause: no per-tenant retry cap + bypass rule = tight retry loops -> livelock.

ana: repro plan: perf-lab simulate 50 tenants hammering same prefix, confirm retry multiplication.

marta: immediate mitigations: map DENIED -> tenant backoff (exp with jitter, min 10ms max 2s); short lease_bump token (100ms) after DENIED; per-tenant in-flight prefetch limit (2).

tessa: longer-term: make tombstone bypass conditional on global_load; add small eviction-signal window (if demote_count>2 in 1s throttle); token-bucket fairness per tenant.

liam: metrics to add: prefetch_retry_count, retry_interval_ms, prefetch_denied_rate, lease_bump_count, per_tenant_inflight_prefetch. alert if retry_count spikes 5x and p95 latency>200ms.

marta: owners: marta implement backoff+lease_bump (PR 48h); ana perf-lab + tests (EOD tomorrow); liam metrics+dashboards; tessa rollout plan + feature flag.

ops-bot: perf-lab job queued (sim-id: prefetch-livelock-sim).

marta: adding global prefetch cap as safety (soft-fail to direct readpath or 503) and strong alert.

ana: perf-lab started, will post results.

liam: rollout: gated feature flag, canary 10% hosts, monitor 2h then widen.

marta: thanks, opening PR with sketch. reconvene if sim reproduces after changes. :thumbsup:
